scope: Only direct-parent AJ shrunk; all three cutoffs; all 10 singles, 120 equal triples, original matched 96 and 320. No fits, no parameter changes. No probability performance test including 2025 H24. Exploratory after seed exposure.
mapping: User's 8 groups, exact frozen names, groups 7/12/8/8/6/21/7/5. 200 size-preserving uniform permutations PCG64(2026110401), held identical for all years. Save all; no selection.
grouping: A=sum mains + within pairs, I=each unordered cross-group pair once, C=A+half of incident I. For original-variable attribution allocate each raw interaction half to each original variable V; also retain native terms and main-only negative controls.
time: Calendar endpoint of each actual firm, both causes at 12 and 24 months, including 2025 H24 explanation only. Native-grid reconstruction on train+eval with zero and leap-day endpoints, all 396 shrunk predictors. Same annual training marginal product. Reuse saved exports, checks <=1e-10, no clipping.
comparison: Every firm and unordered combination pair, strata 0/1/2 shared. Primary = 2100 disjoint pairs. For each firm average valid pair metrics then give equal weight to firms; also describe firm distribution and valid denominators. No inference treating overlapping combinations as independent.
metrics: Average-tie Spearman ranks of absolute contributions; Top3 of 8, Top5 of variable terms, Top1 of four for interpretation; ties by frozen column/key order, magnitude >=.001; undefined empty unions. L1 and relative L1=sum abs diff / sum marginal absolute magnitudes (both zero NA). Sign conditional on both abs>=.001; report common material fraction. Cancellation=1-|A|/(sum absolute native mains and within interactions+1e-15), zero gross NA. Compute per triple AFTER averaging signed raw terms. Group amplitudes = firm mean absolute contribution, plus signed mean and positive/negative material fractions.
random_comparison: Same vector metrics, A/C/four/I, seed pairs, actual firms and allocation for each map. Four random slots match first four group sizes, not economic constructs. Describe map distributions and midrank percentiles. H1 emphasize normalized L1, signed direction and rank together; do not infer from top-k alone. For H2, require economic 8/four C normalized L1 <= random P5 AND rank rho >= random P95 in each primary year for a replicated advantage. Else limited/mixed or INCONCLUSIVE; no formal p-values.
support: On actual annual train joint rows at their calendar endpoints, region where >=90% of 120 triples produce same positive or negative material I (>=0.001 abs). Count distinct firms and observed cause events by min(horizon,cutoff) once. For supported interactions require >=10 such firms, >=3 observed target firms and median train mean absolute I >=0.001. Also report direction-specific support and evidence of underlying native-pair cell support where available; never use theoretical marginal-product mass as joint support.
cases: Fixed original annual snapshot order; private case nearest median across firms of median disjoint C-L1 from previous fixed-cohort sample or, operationally, use the previously registered stable/unstable L1 percentile cases without reselecting. Use the latter archived row keys. Public illustration aggregate lowest/highest quintile of previous L1 (>=5 firms), private real cases. Figures report units, reference, scope, empirical vs product background and descriptive bands.
privacy: No actual cases, predictions, individual identifiers, cuts, fitted objects in git. Suppress positive training event counts 1-4 in public support summaries. No ongoing outcome re-evaluation; do not change old 83 pointer or 74 anchor.
